Video Title: 55 Zikr 23 Oct 1982 By Dr Rashad Khalifa
Text:
Bism Allah Arrahman Arraheem
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
(In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful)
Description: Rashad Khalifa leads a communal zikr (remembrance) session in Tucson, Arizona, opening with the recitation of Suras 113 (Al-Falaq), 114 (Al-Nas), and 1 (Al-Fatihah) in Arabic along with their English translations. Following an opening supplication asking God to accept the congregation's prayers and devotion, Khalifa directs attendees to close their eyes, concentrate, and visualize their souls journeying across galaxies and seven universes to reach the seventh heaven in order to proclaim God's oneness to the angels. The participants engage in sustained communal repetition of the phrase "La Elaha Ella Allah" (There is no god except the One God). Midway through the recording, Khalifa pauses to remind the group to whisper the phrase, maintain focus, and avoid all distractions. The remembrance subsequently transitions into repeated chanting of the divine name "Allah," followed by the attribute "Qayyum" (Absolute and Eternal King), extended cycles of "Subhan Allah" (God be glorified), and a final closing praise of "Alhamdu Lillah."
